[[Image:Jeeves.png|thumb|250px|Jeeves]] '''Jeeves''' is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|GS}}. He was unnamed in the Japanese version. He is [[Madame Muchmoney]]'s main {{wp|butler}}. Jeeves first appeared in ''[[EP124|Snubbull Snobbery]]''. He was seen serving [[Madame Muchmoney's Snubbull]], but the {{type|Normal}} Pokémon rejected him. Jeeves, along with another two butlers, foiled {{TRT}}'s first attempt at kidnapping Snubbull. After Madame Muchmoney learned of her Pokémon's desire for the outdoors, Jeeves formally presented her and Snubbull with a new outdoor exercise area. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} later discovered a disheveled Jeeves out in the middle of the forest in ''[[EP175|The Trouble with Snubbull]]''. He explained that he and Madame Muchmoney had been traveling a lot to try and locate Snubbull so they could bring it back to the [[Palm Hills]] mansion. By the time they recovered her from Team Rocket, she had evolved into a {{p|Granbull}}. Eventually, Jeeves and Madame convinced Granbull to return. He was startled by Madame Muchmoney's newfound strength and confidence, and was forced to run home with her despite having access to a vehicle. ==Trivia== ===Name origin=== Jeeves' English name is derived from the character of {{wp|Reginald Jeeves}}, one of the main characters in the short stories and novels of {{wp|P.G. Wodehouse}}. Both the name "Jeeves" and the character of Jeeves have come to be thought of as the quintessential name and nature of a {{wp|valet}}, {{wp|butler}}, or {{wp|chauffeur}}, and a "Jeeves" is now a generic term in references such as the {{wp|Oxford English Dictionary}}. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=宇垣秀成 ''Hidenari Ugaki'' |en=[[Dan Green]] |ar=جهاد الأطرش ''Jihad Al Attrash'' ([[EP124]])
